title: Go test fixtures read the host's git (auto-maintenance, config, cwd): make them hermetic in one sweep
body: Eight xte findings are one shape: fixtures inherit the host's git config or version or cwd, and go red at base on Apple git or in a linked worktree (1bb7d876, 75456c24, e6926fcb, ec119c6d, 88c1c497, c2848449, e24708aa, ad9dcff8). ad9dcff8 alone broke 20+ tests in the review's run. Grep for the shape and pin the git environment in fixtures, folding in the existing 82e and yjs.
